plain::Vykonáva sa v rozsahu kontrolných: It is carried out within the scope of control items determined by the methodological instructions of the Ministry of Transport of the Slovak Republic, which apply to the inspected vehicle with regard to its:
plain::Vykonáva sa v úplnom alebo čiasto: It is carried out in the full or partial scope of regular technical inspection and according to the inspection items determined by the methodology for carrying out special technical inspection:
plain::na žiadosť prevádzkovateľa alebo: at the request of the operator or driver of the vehicle - to the extent of their verbal request,
plain::ak tak uložil na to príslušný org: if so imposed by the relevant public or state administration body or other institution with similar authority - to the extent of their written decision or similar document,
plain::v prípadoch ustanovených osobitný: in cases established by special regulations, e.g. § 17 or § 29 of the decree of the Ministry of Transport and Construction of the Slovak Republic no. 131/2018 Coll., which establishes details in the area of ​​vehicle approval - to the extent of the relevant provisions of the special regulation in question,
plain::súčasťou je vykonanie kontrolných: part of it is the execution of control items related to identification (plates with registration number, identification number of the vehicle / chassis / serial number, color of the vehicle).
plain::Vykonáva sa v čiastočnom rozsahu: It is carried out in the partial scope of regular technical control and according to control items determined by the methodology for performing administrative technical control.

It is carried out in a partial scope with a focus on checking the removal of errors detected during the technical inspection mentioned in the previous points, within 60 days from the date of the original technical inspection.

plain::Preskúšajte funkčnosť ostrekovačo: Test the functionality of the washers, wipers and horn.
plain::Preverte si vonkajšie osvetlenie: Check the exterior lighting of the vehicle (outline, dipped and main lights, fog lights, direction and reversing lights), fault signaling. Try the headlight dimming functionality.
plain::Skontrolujte či je motorový pries: Check that the engine compartment is dry and that no operating fluids are leaking.
plain::Skontrolujte funkčnosť bŕzd, vrát: Check the operation of the brakes, including the lift height of the parking brake lever.
plain::Preverte si riadenie, či vozidlo: Check the steering, whether the vehicle reacts smoothly to turning the steering wheel and whether the steering wheel returns to its starting position after passing a corner.
plain::Premerajte si dezén pneumatík (pr: Measure the tire tread (prescribed tread depth is at least 3 mm for summer and 1.6 mm for winter tires), make sure you have the prescribed tire size according to the registration certificate.
plain::Skontrolujte zasklenie vozidla –: Check the glazing of the vehicle - there must not be shading films on the front glass and on the front side windows. The shielding film must not cover the rear brake light, the so-called third brake light. Check if the windshield is cracked - the view from the driver's position through the windshield wiper zone is considered impaired if there is no damage in the zone immediately in front of the driver or there are no more than 3 damages of any type smaller than 20 mm outside the zone immediately in front of the driver.
plain::Presvedčte sa či nie je výfukové: Make sure that the exhaust pipe is not loose, leaking or making excessive noise.
plain::Skontrolujte si či sa zhodujú ide: Check whether the identification data in the documents match the actual condition of the vehicle (color, production plate, VIN, EČV).

plain::Ak sa dátum prvého prihlásenia vo: If the date of the vehicle's first entry into the register cannot be ascertained, but the year of manufacture of the vehicle is known, the first day of the vehicle's year of manufacture is considered the first entry of the vehicle into the register.
plain::Ak sa rok prvého prihlásenia vozi: If the year of the vehicle's first entry into the registry indicated in the registration certificate of Part I and in the registration certificate of Part II does not coincide with the year of the vehicle's manufacture, and the difference between the year of the vehicle's manufacture and the year of the vehicle's first entry into the registry is greater than 12 months, the first day of the vehicle's year of manufacture is considered the first entry of the vehicle into the registry.
plain::Ak rok výroby vozidla nie je znám: If the year of manufacture of the vehicle is not known, the model year of the vehicle is considered to be it.
plain::Kedy končí lehota platnosti techn: When does the periodic technical inspection (TK) expire?
plain::vykonaním novej TK pravidelnej,: by performing a new TK regular,
plain::vykonaním novej TK administratívn: by executing a new TK administrative.
plain::Prevádzkovateľ alebo vodič vozidl: The operator or driver of the vehicle is obliged to:
plain::pred začatím TK predložiť doklady: before the start of the TK, submit documents to the extent established by the implementing legislation according to § 136 par. 3 letters g).
plain::pristaviť na TK vozidlo čisté, s: bring a clean vehicle, with mandatory equipment, and vehicles of certain categories also loaded to the extent established by the implementing legislation according to § 136 par. 3 letters g).
plain::pristaviť na TK vozidlo vydezinfi: bring a disinfected vehicle to the TK, if it is an emergency service vehicle intended for the transport of infectious materials or patients with infectious diseases, a vehicle intended for the transport of dead animals and a funeral vehicle, while the disinfection is carried out before the TK is carried out.
plain::byť prítomný pri TK, na kontrolne: to be present at the TK, on ​​the control line the vehicle is driven by a TK technician or on his instructions by the vehicle operator or the driver of the vehicle; the same applies, even if one of the control actions needs to be performed outside the control line or if it is a TK of an individual vehicle with restricted operation according to § 26 par. 3, which can also be done outside STK premises.
plain::Bez predloženia ustanovených dokl: The technical inspection technician may not carry out the technical inspection without presenting the prescribed documents and without the vehicle attached.
plain::Každá kontrolovaná oblasť v rámci: Each controlled area within the technical control contains one or more control items. Each control area contains a list of possible errors and their severity level. During the technical inspection, the technical condition of the vehicle or the function and activities of individual systems, components or separate technical units are evaluated with errors that belong to the following groups of errors:
plain::– nemajú výrazný vplyv na bezpečn: – they do not have a significant impact on the safety of the vehicle or the environment, as well as other less significant cases of non-compliance, the vehicle is FIT for operation in road traffic – the vehicle operator is obliged to remove them.
html::<strong>Ľahké chyby</strong> – nem: Easy mistakes– they do not have a significant impact on the safety of the vehicle or the environment, as well as other less significant cases of non-compliance, the vehicle is FIT for operation in road traffic – the vehicle operator is obliged to remove them.
plain::– môžu ovplyvniť bezpečnosť vozid: – they may affect the safety of the vehicle or the environment, or endanger other road users, as well as other significant cases of non-compliance, the vehicle is TEMPORARY FIT for operation in road traffic – the vehicle operator is obliged to subject the vehicle to a repeated MOT within 60 calendar days. If the same serious fault is detected again by a repeated technical inspection, the vehicle is technically unfit for operation in road traffic. If the vehicle operator does not submit the vehicle to a repeated TK within the established period, the vehicle is technically unfit for operation in road traffic.
html::<strong>Vážne chyby</strong> – môž: Serious mistakes– they may affect the safety of the vehicle or the environment, or endanger other road users, as well as other significant cases of non-compliance, the vehicle is TEMPORARY FIT for operation in road traffic – the vehicle operator is obliged to subject the vehicle to a repeated MOT within 60 calendar days. If the same serious fault is detected again by a repeated technical inspection, the vehicle is technically unfit for operation in road traffic. If the vehicle operator does not submit the vehicle to a repeated TK within the established period, the vehicle is technically unfit for operation in road traffic.
plain::– predstavujú priame a bezprostre: – they pose a direct and immediate risk to road safety or have an impact on the environment and it is necessary to prohibit the use of the vehicle in road traffic, the vehicle is UNFIT for operation in road traffic.
html::<strong>Nebezpečné chyby</strong>: Dangerous errors– they pose a direct and immediate risk to road safety or have an impact on the environment and it is necessary to prohibit the use of the vehicle in road traffic, the vehicle is UNFIT for operation in road traffic.
plain::Vozidlo, na ktorom sa zistia chyb: A vehicle on which defects belonging to more than one defect group are detected will be evaluated according to the defect corresponding to the most serious defect. A vehicle showing multiple defects within the same inspection area according to the definition of the inspection scope can be classified in the nearest group of more serious defects, if it can be demonstrated that the combined effect of these defects results in a higher level of risk to road traffic safety.
plain::Technický stav vozidla sa pri TK: The technical condition of the vehicle is not evaluated at the MOT if all the prescribed inspection items cannot be performed due to a malfunction of some prescribed device from the MOT technological equipment and this situation was not caused by a vehicle fault or the actions of the vehicle driver.
plain::Ak sa pri technickej kontrole zis: If dangerous errors are detected during the technical inspection and the vehicle is assessed as "UNFIT for operation in road traffic", the operation of the vehicle will be suspended - the vehicle operator or the driver of the vehicle is obliged to ensure that the vehicle is towed from the technical inspection station at their own expense.
plain::Technická kontrola sa nevykoná, a: The technical inspection will not be carried out if:
plain::nemožno naštartovať motor vozidla: the vehicle engine cannot be started,
plain::vozidlo má zjavne neúplné výfukov: the vehicle has an obviously incomplete exhaust pipe,
plain::je zistený zjavný únik prevádzkov: an obvious leak of operating media is detected,
plain::vozidlo má poruchu na plynovom za: the vehicle has a fault with the gas device,
plain::niektorá súčasť technologického v: some part of the MOT technological equipment is missing, does not work or does not meet the prescribed conditions,
plain::nie sú splnené požiadavky na prev: the requirements for the operation of all devices making up the MOT technological equipment specified by the manufacturer, especially temperature and humidity, are not met,
plain::prevádzkovateľ vozidla pred techn: the vehicle operator does not submit the prescribed documents before the technical inspection.

plain::Vyznačeným osvedčením o kontrole: With the marked technical condition inspection certificate, part A – technical inspection, the driver of the vehicle proves to the inspection authority supervising the safety and smoothness of road traffic that he has fulfilled the obligation to submit the vehicle to a regular or administrative technical inspection within the time limits, in the manner and to the extent established by the implementing legislation.
plain::Ak ide o vozidlo evidované v inom: If it is a vehicle registered in a country other than the Slovak Republic, equivalent documents issued in this country are the proof of technical inspection.
plain::Prevod držby vozidla alebo zmena: The transfer of ownership of the vehicle or change of ownership of the vehicle does not affect the validity of the technical inspection documents.

plain::Vykonáva sa v rozsahu kontrolných: It is carried out in the range of control items determined by the methodological instructions of the Ministry of Transport for carrying out regular emission control.

plain::Kedy končí lehota platnosti emisn: When does the regular emission control (EK) expire?
plain::vykonaním novej EK pravidelnej,: by executing a new EK regular,
plain::vykonaním novej EK administratívn: by implementing a new EK administrative.
plain::pred začatím EK predložiť doklady: before the start of the EC, submit documents to the extent established by the implementing legislation according to § 136 par. 3 letters h).
plain::pristaviť na EK vozidlo čisté, ud: present a clean vehicle, maintained in a technical condition, in which it meets the established technical requirements for operating the vehicle in road traffic according to the operating and maintenance instructions established by the manufacturer and in a technical condition that allows for the emission control to be carried out without damaging the vehicle, the emission control workplace or the health of people present during the emission control,
plain::pristaviť na EK vozidlo vydezinfi: bring a disinfected vehicle to the EK, if it is an emergency service vehicle intended for the transport of infectious materials or patients with infectious diseases, a vehicle intended for the transport of dead animals and a funeral vehicle, while the disinfection is carried out before the EK is carried out.
plain::Bez predloženia ustanovených dokl: Without presenting the prescribed documents and without the vehicle, the emission control technician may not perform the emission control.
plain::Pri emisnej kontrole sa emisný st: During emission control, the emission status of a motor vehicle or the function and activities of individual systems, components or separate technical units, which affect the formation of pollutants in the vehicle's exhaust gases, are evaluated using a three-level classification.
plain::Vozidlo sa hodnotí podľa zoznamu: The vehicle is evaluated according to a list of possible faults and their level of severity. Errors mean technical malfunctions and other cases of non-compliance detected during emission control, namely:
plain::, ktoré nemajú výrazný vplyv na ž: , which do not have a significant impact on the environment or on the safety and operation of the vehicle, as well as other less significant cases of non-compliance, the vehicle is FIT for operation in road traffic - the vehicle operator is obliged to remove them.
html::<strong>Ľahké chyby</strong>, ktor: Easy mistakes, which do not have a significant impact on the environment or on the safety and operation of the vehicle, as well as other less significant cases of non-compliance, the vehicle is FIT for operation in road traffic - the vehicle operator is obliged to remove them.
plain::, ktoré môžu ovplyvniť bezpečnosť: , which may affect the safety of the vehicle or the environment or endanger other road users, as well as other significant cases of non-compliance, the vehicle is TEMPORARILY FIT for operation in road traffic - the vehicle operator is obliged to submit the vehicle to a repeated EC within 60 calendar days. If the same serious fault is detected again by the repeated emission control, the vehicle is unfit for operation in road traffic. If the vehicle operator does not subject the vehicle to a repeated EC within the established period, the vehicle is unfit for operation in road traffic.
html::<strong>Vážne chyby</strong>, ktor: Serious mistakes, which may affect the safety of the vehicle or the environment or endanger other road users, as well as other significant cases of non-compliance, the vehicle is TEMPORARILY FIT for operation in road traffic - the vehicle operator is obliged to submit the vehicle to a repeated EC within 60 calendar days. If the same serious fault is detected again by the repeated emission control, the vehicle is unfit for operation in road traffic. If the vehicle operator does not subject the vehicle to a repeated EC within the established period, the vehicle is unfit for operation in road traffic.
plain::, ktoré predstavujú priame a bezp: , which pose a direct and immediate risk to road safety or have an impact on the environment and it is necessary to prohibit the use of the vehicle in road traffic, the vehicle is UNFIT for operation in road traffic.
html::<strong>Nebezpečné chyby</strong>,: Dangerous errors, which pose a direct and immediate risk to road safety or have an impact on the environment and it is necessary to prohibit the use of the vehicle in road traffic, the vehicle is UNFIT for operation in road traffic.
plain::Ak sa pri emisnej kontrole zistia: If dangerous errors are detected during the emission control and the vehicle is assessed as "UNFIT for operation in road traffic", the operation of the vehicle will be suspended - the vehicle operator or the driver of the vehicle is obliged to arrange for the towing of the vehicle from the emission control workplace at their own expense.
plain::prevádzkovateľ motorového vozidla: the operator of the motor vehicle does not submit the prescribed documents before the emission control.

plain::Protokol o vykonanej emisnej kont: The protocol on the performed emission control is kept at the workplace of emission control for four years from the issuance of the protocol.
plain::Vyznačeným osvedčením o kontrole: With the marked technical condition inspection certificate, part B – emission inspection, the driver of the vehicle proves to the inspection authority supervising the safety and smoothness of road traffic that he has fulfilled the obligation to submit the vehicle to a regular or administrative emission inspection within the time limits, in the manner and to the extent established by the implementing legislation.
plain::Ak ide o vozidlo evidované v inom: If it is a vehicle registered in another member state or contracting state, equivalent documents issued in this member state or contracting state are the proof of technical inspection.
plain::Prevod držby vozidla alebo zmena: The transfer of ownership of the vehicle or change of ownership of the vehicle does not affect the validity of the emission control documents.
plain::Kontrolou originality (KO) je kon: The originality check (KO) is the check of the originality and conformity of the vehicle carried out by measurement and non-destructive examination aimed at detecting traces of unauthorized external intervention in the vehicle identifiers, in the vehicle structure or in the vehicle documents.
plain::Kontrola originality na pracovisk: The originality control at the originality control workplace is carried out according to the individual types of controls within the scope of the established control actions
plain::o prevádzke vozidiel v cestnej pr: on the operation of vehicles in road traffic, implementing legislation according to § 136 par. 3 letters i) and according to the methodologies issued by the type approval authority.
html::Kontrola originality na pracovisku: The originality control at the originality control workplace is carried out according to the individual types of controls within the scope of the established control actionsby law no. 106/2018 Coll.on the operation of vehicles in road traffic, implementing legislation according to § 136 par. 3 letters i) and according to the methodologies issued by the type approval authority.
plain::Druhy kontroly originality, ktoré: Types of originality checks we perform:
plain::Vykonáva sa v rozsahu:: It is carried out in the scope of:
plain::merania a nedeštruktívneho skúman: measurement and non-destructive examination of traces, unauthorized external interference with vehicle identifiers, vehicle structure or vehicle documents,
plain::porovnania údajov nachádzajúcich: comparison of the data found on the vehicle with the data listed in the documents and in the available databases,
plain::kontroly a posúdenia stavu identi: checks and assessments of the condition of vehicle identifiers according to the control procedures established by the methodology for performing basic originality checks,
plain::porovnania údajov nachádzajúcich: comparison of the data found on the vehicle and the data listed in the vehicle documents with the data in the vehicle registry, if it is a vehicle registered in the registry,
plain::overenia údajov o vozidle v pátra: verification of data on the vehicle in the search records for the purpose of finding out its theft or the theft of the vehicle's documents or for the purpose of whether a plate or plates with a registration number or with a special registration number for which the search is declared has not been used on the vehicle.
plain::Vykonáva sa v skrátenom rozsahu a: It is performed in a reduced scope as a basic originality check. The abbreviated scope of the originality check is in the inspection and assessment of the condition of the vehicle identifiers according to the control actions determined by the methodology for carrying out the abbreviated originality check.
plain::Vykonáva sa v čiastočnom rozsahu: It is carried out in the partial scope of the basic originality check or the abbreviated originality check and according to the control actions determined by the methodology for performing the administrative originality check.

It is carried out in the partial scope of the basic originality check or the abbreviated originality check and according to the control actions determined by the methodology for carrying out the originality check of the records.

It is carried out in a partial scope with a focus on checking the removal of errors detected during the basic, abbreviated, administrative and record originality check, within 30 days from the date of the original check.
plain::Účelom kontroly originality je ov: The purpose of the originality check is to verify the condition of the vehicle's suitability for road traffic.
plain::Výsledok kontroly originality je: The result of the originality check is recorded in the information system of the originality check and the Expert opinion on the originality check of the vehicle.
plain::identifikátory vozidla (identifik: vehicle identifiers (vehicle identification number VIN and other vehicle markings),
plain::komponenty určujúce identitu vozi: components determining the identity of the vehicle with the vehicle documents, their originality and authenticity, as well as the evaluation of data in the relevant information systems.
plain::Odborný posudok o kontrole origin: An expert opinion on originality control is required in the following cases:

plain::Prevádzkovateľ vozidla alebo vodi: In addition to the identity card, the vehicle operator or the driver of the vehicle submits the following documents for the originality check, if it concerns:
plain::Vozidlo prihlásené do evidencie v: Vehicle registered in the vehicle register in the Slovak Republic:
plain::osvedčenie o evidencii časť I a o: certificate of registration part I and certificate of registration part II, if issued, or a document on reporting the loss or theft of a certificate issued by an authority of the Police Force, or a document on the retention of a certificate issued by an authority of the Police Force; in the case of a document on the report of loss or theft or a document on the retention of the Part II registration certificate, an up-to-date copy or replacement of the Part II registration certificate bearing the imprint of the stamp of the Police Force authority is also submitted,
plain::doklad o nadobudnutí karosérie vo: proof of acquisition of the vehicle body or vehicle frame, which is presented when replacing the vehicle body or vehicle frame,
plain::doklad o vykonaní hromadnej prest: a document on the execution of a mass conversion of the vehicle type, which is submitted if it is a vehicle on which a mass conversion of the vehicle type is carried out,
plain::rozhodnutie o povolení prestavby: the decision to permit the conversion of an individual vehicle, which is submitted if it is a conversion of an individual vehicle,
plain::Jednotlivo dovezené vozidlo, ktor: An individually imported vehicle that is registered in the vehicle registry:
plain::osvedčenie o evidencii z krajiny: certificate of registration from the country of origin or from the state in which it is registered, in the case of two parts of the certificate of registration, both parts must be submitted; if the certificates are in a language other than Slovak or Czech, they are submitted with an official translation into the state language, while in the case of a harmonized registration certificate issued in a member state, only the parts that are not subject to harmonization are officially translated,
plain::doklad o vyradení vozidla z evide: proof of decommissioning of the vehicle from the vehicle registry in the state in which it is registered, together with an official translation into the state language, if the decommissioning document is in a language other than Slovak or Czech; it is submitted only if such a document is issued in the country of export,
plain::doklad o prepustení vozidla do vo: a document on the release of the vehicle into free circulation, which is submitted if it is a vehicle imported from a third country or from a contracting state,
plain::Jednotlivo dovezené vozidlo, ktor: An individually imported vehicle that is not registered in the vehicle register and has a technical vehicle certificate issued:
plain::technické osvedčenie vozidla spol: vehicle technical certificate together with an official translation into the state language, if the certificate is in a language other than Slovak or Czech,
plain::Jednotlivo dovezené vozidlo, ktor: An individually imported vehicle that is not registered in the vehicle registry:
plain::vyhlásenie žiadateľa, že vozidlo: the applicant's declaration that the vehicle is not registered in the vehicle registry in another state,
plain::osvedčenie o zhode COC, ak má voz: COC certificate of conformity if the vehicle has been granted EU type approval or
plain::originál alebo kópiu vnútroštátne: the original or a copy of the national vehicle conformity certificate confirming the vehicle's conformity with the national requirements of a member state or a contracting state, or
plain::návrh na spracovanie základného t: a proposal for the processing of the basic technical description of the vehicle issued by the technical verification service or a document issued by the manufacturer or the representative of the manufacturer, from which it follows that this type of vehicle has a valid basic technical description of the vehicle in the Slovak Republic; it is submitted if the vehicle has not been granted EU type approval or the vehicle has not been granted vehicle type approval or the vehicle has not been granted individual vehicle approval granted in a member state or a contracting state of the Agreement on the European Economic Area and the Swiss Confederation,
plain::Vozidlo vyradené z evidencie vozi: A vehicle removed from the vehicle register before re-approval for operation in road traffic:
plain::osvedčenie o evidencii časť II, a: registration certificate part II, if issued, or a document on reporting the loss or theft of a certificate issued by an authority of the Police Force, or a document on the retention of a certificate issued by an authority of the Police Force; in the case of a document on the report of loss or theft or a document on the retention of the Part II registration certificate, an up-to-date copy or replacement of the Part II registration certificate bearing the imprint of the stamp of the Police Force authority is also submitted,
plain::doklad orgánu Policajného zboru o: a document from the Police authority on the notification of the theft of the vehicle, if it is a vehicle removed from the vehicle registry due to its theft,
a document from the police authority on the return of the vehicle, if it is a vehicle removed from the vehicle registry due to its theft,

document of the Police authority on the removal of the vehicle from the vehicle registry; the document does not need to be submitted, if the original vehicle documents or the original plate with the registration number are submitted, which prove the registration of the vehicle in the vehicle registry in the Slovak Republic,
plain::Vozidlo, ktoré nepodliehalo prihl: A vehicle that was not subject to registration in the vehicle registry:
plain::doklad o nahlásení straty alebo o: a document on reporting the loss or theft of the vehicle's technical certificate issued by the Police Force,
plain::Vozidlo, ktoré nie je prihlásené: A vehicle that is not registered in the vehicle register and is not imported individually:
plain::osvedčenie o evidencii časť II, a: registration certificate part II, if it is issued or issued, or a document on reporting the loss or theft of a certificate issued by an authority of the Police Force, or a document on the retention of a certificate issued by an authority of the Police Force,
plain::osvedčenie o zhode COC, ak má voz: COC certificate of conformity if the vehicle has been granted EU type approval,
plain::Vozidlo záchrannej služby, na pre: Emergency service vehicle, for the transport of dead animals and a funeral vehicle:
plain::okrem dokladov uvedených v predch: in addition to the documents mentioned in the previous paragraphs, he also submits a confirmation of the disinfection of the vehicle carried out before the originality check.
plain::Notárske overenie potvrdzuje zhod: Notary verification confirms that the content of the copy of the document matches the original. It does not confirm the authenticity of the original document, because the notary does not verify the authenticity of the covering protective elements of the original document, which are verified during the originality check. Of course, the copy of the document does not contain any original protective elements from the original document, so it can only be used to obtain data, not to check the originality.
plain::Pre kontrolu originality sa strik: In order to check the originality, it is strictly required to present the original document from the country of import.
plain::Kedy je potrebné predložiť pri ko: When is it necessary to submit a translation of the document during the originality check?
plain::Preklady registračných dokladov o: Translations of registration documents from the vehicle into the national language must be submitted if they are in a language other than Slovak or Czech, and that is if it concerns:
plain::jednotlivo dovezené vozidlo, ktor: an individually imported vehicle that is registered in the vehicle registry requires a translation of the registration certificate from the country of origin or from the state in which it is registered, while in the case of a harmonized registration certificate issued in a member state, only parts that are not subject to harmonization are officially translated;
an individually imported vehicle that is not registered in the vehicle register and has an issued technical vehicle certificate, a translation of the technical certificate is required.
plain::Povinnosť predkladania prekladu d: The obligation to submit a translation of documents is regulated in more detail by § 36 of the Decree of the Ministry of Transport and Construction of the Slovak Republic No. 139/2018 Z. z..
plain::Popis harmonizovaných položiek up: The description of harmonized items is governed by § 3 of the Decree of the Ministry of Transport and Construction of the Slovak Republic No. 133/2018 Z. z..
plain::Preklady registračných dokladov s: Translations of registration documents are also required during the originality check in cases where
plain::zahraničné osvedčenie o evidencii: the foreign registration certificate contains notes that are not related to the originality check (e.g. notes contain data on the emission class, change in design speed, etc.);
the foreign registration certificate contains text notes that follow the harmonized parts.
plain::Preklady registračných dokladov n: Translations of registration documents are not required when checking originality if
plain::zahraničné osvedčenie o evidencii: the foreign registration certificate contains only harmonized parts (most Dutch and Austrian documents);
the foreign registration certificate contains, in addition to the harmonized data, only numerical notes that follow the harmonized parts;
the foreign registration certificate contains, in addition to the harmonized data, only the marking of the registration of the vehicle.

plain::byť prítomný pri KO, počas výkonu: to be present at the KO, during the performance of the originality control he must not stay on the control line, he can stay in the premises of the originality control workplace reserved for customers.
plain::Bez predloženia ustanovených dokl: Without presenting the prescribed documents and without the vehicle attached, the originality control technician may not carry out the originality check.
plain::Hodnotenie vozidla sa hodnotí štv: The vehicle rating is assessed using a four-level classification:
plain::identifikátory vozidla sú nedotkn: the vehicle identifiers are intact, there are no visible traces of unauthorized external intervention or external unauthorized interventions in the vehicle structure have not been detected, or the change in identifiers or the vehicle structure is caused by an authorized conversion
plain::na identifikátoroch vozidla nasta: vehicle identifiers have changed due to external influences and forces, are unreadable or cannot be determined, or tampering with the vehicle's structure has been detected
plain::údaje na identifikátoroch vozidla: the data on the vehicle identifiers are changed as a result of unauthorized external intervention, or the vehicle consists of parts with different identification data, or unauthorized interventions have been detected in the vehicle structure, or unauthorized interventions have been detected in the part on which the vehicle identification number VIN is located
the data on the vehicle identifiers are missing or the body part on which the manufacturer placed the vehicle identification number VIN has been removed
plain::požadované doklady nenesú žiadnu: the requested documents do not bear any sign of falsity and the data contained in them correspond to the data on the identifiers of the inspected vehicle or the data change is caused by an authorized conversion of the vehicle
plain::požadované doklady nenesú známku: the requested documents do not bear the mark of falsity, but the data contained in them probably do not match the data on the identifiers of the inspected vehicle due to an incorrect entry
plain::niektorý z požadovaných dokladov: any of the required vehicle documents has altered data or is a forgery
plain::údaje v dokladoch sú nečitateľné: the data in the documents are illegible or missing
plain::STAV ÚDAJOV V EVIDENCII VOZIDIEL:: STATUS OF DATA IN THE VEHICLE REGISTRY:
plain::údaje v evidencii vozidiel sa zho: the data in the vehicle register match the data on the identifiers of the inspected vehicle and the required documents in full, or the change in data is caused by an authorized conversion of the vehicle
plain::údaje v evidencii vozidiel sa pra: the data in the vehicle register probably do not match the data on the inspected vehicle's identifiers in full due to an incorrect entry
plain::v informačných systémoch, ktoré v: a record of the search was found in the information systems maintained by the Police Force
plain::v evidencii vozidiel sa nenašiel: no record of the inspected vehicle was found in the vehicle register

plain::Výsledok kontroly originality evi: The result of checking the originality of the registration has no effect on the vehicle's ability to operate in road traffic.
plain::Kontrola originality sa nevykoná,: The originality check will not be carried out if:
plain::niektorá súčasť technologického v: some part of the technological equipment of the originality control workplace is missing, does not work or does not meet the prescribed conditions,
plain::nie sú splnené požiadavky na prev: the requirements for the operation of all devices forming the technological equipment of the originality control workplace specified by the manufacturer, especially temperature and humidity, are not met.
plain::Vozidlo sa musí podrobiť kontrole: The vehicle must undergo an originality check when notified or found to be on the vehicle
plain::sú vykonané neoprávnené zásahy do: unauthorized interventions are made to its identifiers, construction or its documents or
plain::sa nachádzajú pozmenené, poškoden: there are altered, damaged or illegible vehicle identifiers, or
plain::je identifikačné číslo vozidla VI: is a vehicle identification number (VIN) that was never produced by the manufacturer.
plain::Ak ide o vozidlo, ktoré presahuje: If it is a vehicle that exceeds the largest permitted dimensions or the largest permitted weight and its inspection is not possible at the originality inspection control line, the conditions for carrying out the originality inspection of such a vehicle shall be determined by the approval authority.
plain::Výsledok kontroly originality sa: The result of the originality check is recorded according to the type of originality check through the national information system in:
plain::Odborný posudok o kontrole origin: Expert opinion on checking the originality of the vehicle
plain::Protokol o kontrole originality e: Protocol on checking the originality of the record
plain::Odborný posudok o kontrole origin: The expert opinion on checking the originality of the vehicle and the protocol on checking the originality of the registration are kept for five years.
plain::Ak je vozidlo pri kontrole origin: If the vehicle is evaluated during the originality check as:
plain::Technik kontroly originality vyzn: The originality control technician will mark detected errors and the note "vehicle identifiers are legible and safely determinable" or the note "vehicle identifiers are not readable and safely determinable" in the expert report.
The originality control technician will mark the detected errors in the expert opinion.
plain::Ak technici na pracovisku KO zist: If the technicians at the KO workplace find traces of unauthorized intervention in the vehicle identifiers, vehicle documents or detect a search for the vehicle, they will issue an Expert Report with the rating "unfit", while the identified deficiencies will be recorded in the KO result (e.g. missing production plate, inconsistency in the documents, unreadable VIN, VIN in the search...).
plain::Zistenú skutočnosť musia oznámiť: They must report the fact to the Police because there is reasonable suspicion that a crime has been committed (e.g. § 220 of the Criminal Code, Falsification and alteration of motor vehicle identification data). The police will seize the vehicle or the documents for further investigation.
plain::Ak sa potvrdí manipulácia a podoz: If tampering and the suspicion of committing a crime are confirmed, the original identity of the vehicle is further determined.
plain::Ak sa podarí vozidlo identifikova: If the vehicle can be identified and thus the original VIN found, its occurrence in the search is verified.
plain::Ak sa vozidlo vyskytuje v pátraní: If the vehicle is found in the search and can be returned (e.g. it is not assembled from several vehicles, the original owner is known,...), it is returned to the original owner.
plain::Ak sa v pátraní nevyskytuje a bol: If it is not found in the search and unauthorized manipulation has been confirmed, the vehicle is returned as unfit for operation in road traffic after securing the evidence, the registration certificate and plates with the registration number are taken away, and the vehicle is removed from the vehicle registry.
plain::Ak sa ale pozmeňovanie a falšovan: However, if the alteration and falsification of identification data is not confirmed, the vehicle is returned. Because it is not allowed to rewrite the results of the KO in the original Expert Assessment, it is necessary to pass a repeated KO to issue a new Expert Assessment with the rating "suitable".
plain::Falšovanie a pozmeňovanie identif: Falsifying and altering the identification data of a motor vehicle is a criminal offense* with a penalty of up to 3 years in prison in the basic facts. If the offender commits this crime:
plain::a už bol za taký čin odsúdený, sp: and has already been convicted of such an act, causes greater damage or for a special motive - he faces a prison sentence
html::a už bol za taký čin odsúdený, spô: and has already been convicted of such an act, causes greater damage or for a special motive - he faces a prison sentence1 year to 5 years,
plain::závažnejším spôsobom konania aleb: in a more serious way of acting or causes significant damage - he faces a prison sentence
html::závažnejším spôsobom konania alebo: in a more serious way of acting or causes significant damage - he faces a prison sentence3 years to 8 years,
plain::a spôsobí škodu veľkého rozsahu a: and causes damage on a large scale or as a member of a dangerous group - he faces a prison sentence
html::a spôsobí škodu veľkého rozsahu al: and causes damage on a large scale or as a member of a dangerous group - he faces a prison sentence4 years to 10 years.

plain::Áno. S cieľom zamedzenia podvodov: Yes. With the aim of preventing fraud related to the abuse of delayed registrations of vehicle blockages, the Slovak Chamber of Executors started using an information system in October 2011, which allows executors to write blockages directly online in the vehicle register. In order for the interested party to be able to verify before the purchase whether there is no blocking on a particular vehicle, the verification of the blocking of the vehicle in the vehicle register has become an integral part of the vehicle originality check, and the result of the verification is also automatically entered in the Expert opinion on the vehicle originality check.
plain::Verejnosť si môže overiť blokáciu: The public can verify the blocking of the vehicle at the time of the originality check directly through the Verification of the KO result. The verification refers to the date and time of the originality check, so if you are buying a vehicle at a distance, it is important to verify the blocking in real time. This is possible on the website of the Registry of Vehicle Operating Records
